paragraphs: In [Niddah 40a](https://www.sefaria.org/Niddah.40a.8), Bar Leivai taught. In [Zevachim 115a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.115a.12), when Rav Dimi came, he reported a teaching of the school of Bar Leivai. In [Shabbat 108b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.108b.12), Bar Leivai was standing before Mar Ukva. Hyman adds that Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi is also called Bar Leivai and refers to his entry.[^1]

notes.text: The supplied בגדה is compared with Niddah’s matching teaching. The consulted Zevachim names the school of Rabbi Leivai, where Hyman gives Bar Leivai. Shabbat has Bar Leivai before Mar Ukva.
